correctItems.text: In fact, all the affairs of the company are governed by the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013.

correctItems.text: • Separate Legal Entity: A company has a separate legal entity which is distinct and separate from its members.

But neither it is possible for all of them to participate in the management of the company nor considered desirable. Therefore, they elect a Board of Directors as their representative to manage the affairs of the company.

correctItems.text: • Perpetual Succession: The company being an artificial person created by law continues to exist irrespective of the changes in its membership.
The death or insanity or insolvency of any member of the company in no way affects the existence of the company.
• Common Seal: The company being an artificial person, cannot sign its name by itself.
Therefore, every company is required to have its own seal which acts as official signatures of the company.
